procedures.title: Wheels and tires specifications: Corvette tire usage and inflation pressures

specs.value: 1 to 2 Passengers + 150 Lbs. Luggage (450 Lbs. Load)

notes: Section 10. The standard pressure covers all loads including full rated load and continuous high-speed operation (over 75 MPH). * Optional tires are not available.
Tire pressures may rise as much as 6 psi when hot.
Cool pressure means the car has stood 3 hours or more, or been driven under 1 mile; hot means after 10 miles or more at 60-70 MPH.
Cars with luggage racks have no higher load limit than shown. When towing a trailer, reduce passenger and cargo load by the trailer tongue load.
